l7r/diagram/interactive/place.py::KINDS#.note: 0001 answers this, and the other way: a provincial city's "about 3,000 ... counts only those living within the walls". Either 0001 records the GM's feature-156 ruling, or the claim cites 0001 and the text in place.json follows it. I could not see place.json's wording
the hamlet has no cremation ground or burial ground of its own, and its dead are burned and buried at the main village's

Two parts of the tier text contradict the question. (1) The city's population_note says the figure "does take in the samurai country estates around the city", but the question says it "counts only those living within the walls" and that an estate "stands apart" (§17, §16). (2) The village's "what" says "its tax-free plots", but the question gives one: "one plot of tax-free land" (§5, §7). The other parts match: hamlets per domain 1296/216/40% (§8), no headman and no shrine for a hamlet (§5), the town's 1200 people and 238 households with about two in three farming (§11, §12), not counting the villages (§13), and samurai first appearing at town level (§15). The text should say walls-only and one plot, or the claim should cite a DEVIATION.
